negative_reviews.author: Mali Griffiths
negative_reviews.text: The restaraunt was quite slow service and forgot a lot of our items and we had to ask multiple times for them. But to be fair to them they did give us 25% off our bill. Probably wouldn’t recommend. Thanks

negative_reviews.author: Maria Salamanca
negative_reviews.text: Had super high expectations given the good reviews but the service was really bad… servers were unfriendly, mains came out at very different times so one of us was done eating by the time the other’s main came and there were lots of dirty tables around us. The food was ok but the ramen was served a bit cold.

negative_reviews.author: Maya “mayaearth” Earth
negative_reviews.text:
I went for dinner there today, food was delicious but the service was quiet bad.
I've ordered 2 ramen and 2 side dishes, I've made sure to mention that we would start with the side dishes and then the ramen, specifying to the manager who was taking orders on her pad, the extra beef topping that would go for both. Few minutes later they serve us one ramen. We ask if the second one is coming they say yes. Then the manager comes 5 minutes later, saying we ordered only one ramen, wish I anwser that we ordered two, she ask if we could have this one for now, as it will go soggy. I tell her that I won't be eating the ramen by myself while my partner is watching. She just storms off without a word. When the bill came we noticed that she charged us for three ramen, the other waitress took care of rectifying the bill, we saw that manager coming to her with a smirk to ask what was going on. At the end it got sorted, but we felt that this lady managing, and taking order, needs way more training in customer service, and stop trying to sneakly scam people by adding more to the bill to cover for her own mistake. None of less food was delicious  especially the teriyaki chiken, I would've recommended this restaurant, if it wasn't for this women.
